_comment: Schema for the CNCF Platform Engineering Maturity Model self-assessment.
This file is maintained BY HAND (qualitative self-assessment, not API-derived).
Edit it when the project re-assesses itself against the model.
Reference: https://tag-app-delivery.cncf.io/whitepapers/platform-eng-maturity-model/
Top-level fields:
model         (string)  Name of the model this assessment follows.
model_url     (string)  Canonical URL of the model.
assessed_at   (string)  Date of the current assessment, ISO 8601 YYYY-MM-DD.
levels        (object)  Ordered level names keyed by '1'..'5'. The CNCF model
names are: 1 Provisional, 2 Operational, 3 Scale, 4 Optimize.
Key '5' is reserved for a future/aspirational level and is
rendered as part of the 1-5 scale on the radar chart only.
dimensions    (array)   One object per maturity dimension (order is preserved on the page):
key         (string)  Stable machine name, lowercase (e.g. 'provisioning').
label       (string)  Display name (e.g. 'Provisioning').
level       (integer) Current self-assessed level, 1-5 inclusive.
evidence    (string)  What exists today that justifies this level.
gap         (string)  What is missing to reach the next level.
last_assessed (string) Date this dimension was last (re)scored, YYYY-MM-DD.
history       (array)   Append-only log of past assessments, oldest first:
date        (string)  Assessment date, YYYY-MM-DD.
note        (string)  What changed or why the assessment happened.
scores      (object)  Snapshot of dimension key -> level at that date.

dimensions.label: Provisioning
dimensions.evidence: Images are built and published declaratively via GitHub Actions and bootc; base images, tags, and update streams are fully automated and reproducible.
dimensions.gap: Self-service provisioning of custom image variants by contributors is still manual (fork-and-edit rather than a service catalog).

dimensions.label: Configuration
dimensions.evidence: system_files, dconf overrides, and image configuration are version-controlled and applied uniformly across variants; shared configuration lives in bluefin-common.
dimensions.gap: Configuration drift detection between variants and post-deployment compliance reporting are not yet systematic.

dimensions.label: Observability
dimensions.evidence: This dashboard aggregates build health, DORA metrics, supply-chain signals, and adoption (countme) data across the ecosystem with daily refresh and smoke tests.
dimensions.gap: No end-user runtime telemetry or alerting on image update failures in the field; signals are build-time and aggregate only.

dimensions.label: Onboarding
dimensions.evidence: Documented installation media, website docs, and a working 'ujust' first-boot experience get new users to a running system.
dimensions.gap: Contributor onboarding remains tribal knowledge; no paved-path templates or guided contribution workflows for new image variants.

dimensions.label: Workflows
dimensions.evidence: CI/CD pipelines cover build, test, sign, and publish for every image; shared reusable workflows and Renovate keep toil low across repos.
dimensions.gap: Promotion between streams (testing -> stable) still requires manual judgement; progressive delivery is not automated.

dimensions.label: Security
dimensions.evidence: All images are signed with cosign, SBOMs are generated at build time, base images are rebuilt daily, and OpenSSF Scorecard is tracked on this dashboard.
dimensions.gap: Vulnerability triage SLAs and runtime security policy enforcement are informal and maintainer-driven.

dimensions.label: Cost
dimensions.evidence: CI minutes, registry storage, and CDN usage are within free/donated tiers; build frequency is tuned to balance freshness against runner time.
dimensions.gap: No per-image or per-variant cost attribution; capacity decisions are made ad hoc rather than against measured unit cost.

history.note: Initial self-assessment recorded when this page was introduced.
